findings.summary: All four runtime lanes pass the upstream CPU membrane tolerances and exact final spike-mask oracle for canonical, 65,536-neuron, and parameter-override LIF cases on the physical Radeon Vulkan adapter.
Each lane is nondegenerately repeatable, W0 and D0 replay exactly, and Dawn and Doe produce identical GPU membrane and spike bytes for every frozen case on this adapter.

The governed incumbent satisfies the same live-provider, semantic-oracle, repeatability, and replay outcomes as Doe. No bounded correction is needed and this workload supplies no DoeRuntime ownership advantage.

limitations: The result covers one AMD Vulkan adapter and does not establish cross-vendor byte identity.
The original upstream cross-vendor script has a broken relative dist import; the harness invokes the unchanged exported production functions directly.
Three clean processes per lane remain below the promotion reliability floor.
No selected-operation performance comparison was run.
The result is a diagnostic regression and does not prove adoption.

performance.reason: The frozen workload adjudicates correctness and determinism, not selected-operation performance.

receiptOverhead.reason: No receipt-overhead timing claim was admitted.

I0.summary: The ambient incumbent passes every frozen oracle and repeatability obligation.

I1.summary: The explicitly pinned incumbent passes every frozen obligation.

W0.summary: The governed incumbent passes exact semantic replay.

D0.summary: Doe passes the same semantic and replay contract.

P0.summary: W0 exposes no frozen defect requiring a bounded correction.

materialOutcome.summary: D0 supplies no semantic or reproducibility outcome unavailable from W0.

costAcceptance.summary: No unique application outcome exists to repay DoeRuntime ownership costs.

installation.summary: The diagnostic uses a prepared upstream workspace and source provider path.

supportHardware.summary: Every lane binds the physical Radeon Vulkan adapter and rejects software fallback.

teardown.summary: Processes and simulators exit cleanly, but promotion-scale teardown was not run.

memory.summary: Peak process memory is recorded, but bounded-growth testing was not run.

receipts.summary: The matrix binds its provider, runtime, upstream implementation, shader, oracle, inputs, and runner.

replay.summary: W0 and D0 independently reproduce their semantic evidence.

ownership.summary: The governed incumbent and Doe satisfy the same application outcome.

release.summary: The harness remains diagnostic and cannot block a release.
